game_info.title: LICHCRAFT
game_info.description: A trans cyberpunk RPG about transformation, resistance, and becoming undead to outlast corporate healthcare waiting lists

steps.prompt: What is your Prime subscription tier?
Where does your magical affinity come from?
Assign your attribute values: 3 (highest), 2 (medium), and 1 (lowest) to Strength, Sense, and Spells.

resistance_contact.name: Ash
resistance_contact.title: Resistance Member
resistance_contact.description: A hooded figure with cybernetic enhancements. They seem to know more than they let on.

old_librarian.name: Dr. Morgan
old_librarian.title: Former Academic
old_librarian.description: An elderly person surrounded by ancient texts and data tablets.

prime_drone_operator.name: Taylor
prime_drone_operator.title: Prime Drone Operator
prime_drone_operator.description: Your coworker who operates delivery drones. They seem burnt out.

mysterious_vendor.name: The Collector
mysterious_vendor.title: Artifact Trader
mysterious_vendor.description: A shadowy vendor dealing in rare and magical items.

prime_officer.name: Officer Kane
prime_officer.title: Prime Enforcement Officer
prime_officer.description: A Prime Enforcement Officer with cold, calculating eyes.

trans_elder.name: Raven
trans_elder.title: Community Elder
trans_elder.description: An elder in the trans community who has seen decades of struggle.

home.name: Your Apartment
home.description: A cramped studio apartment in the Prime Housing Complex. Your subscription tier barely covers rent. Through the window, you see endless drones delivering packages.

city_streets.name: Prime City Streets
city_streets.description: Neon signs advertise Prime services everywhere. Surveillance drones hover overhead. Citizens hurry past, eyes down, avoiding attention.

underground_market.name: Underground Market
underground_market.description: Hidden beneath the city, this black market thrives outside Prime's surveillance. The air smells of ozone and desperation. People trade contraband, information, and hope.

abandoned_library.name: Abandoned Library
abandoned_library.description: This pre-Prime library was supposed to be demolished. Books gather dust alongside broken data terminals. Knowledge Prime wanted to erase.

hiddenItems.name: Ancient Tome
hiddenItems.description: A book on pre-corporate magical traditions

abandoned_district.name: Abandoned District
abandoned_district.description: Prime abandoned this area after extracting all value. Crumbling buildings and forgotten streets. Some say magic still lingers here.

prime_facility.name: Prime Healthcare Center
prime_facility.description: Gleaming white walls and the smell of sanitizer. Staff move efficiently between stations. Your 300-year waiting list position mocks you from a screen.

safe_house.name: Community Safe House
safe_house.description: A secret space where trans folks gather, share resources, and support each other. The walls are covered in art and mutual aid posters. This place feels like home.

ritual_site.name: The Forgotten Place
ritual_site.description: An ancient site of power, untouched by Prime. The air crackles with possibility. This is where transformation begins.

prime_train.name: Prime High-Speed Train
prime_train.description: Luxury transport for Premium subscribers. The train hums with barely contained energy as it speeds through underground tunnels.

security_drone.name: Prime Security Drone
security_drone.description: An automated security drone with taser appendages.

lich_bezos.name: Lich J*ff B*zos
lich_bezos.description: The immortal founder of Prime, a skeletal figure in an executive suit.

health_pack.name: Medical Kit
health_pack.description: A basic medical kit. Restores 3 HP.

ancient_tome.name: Tome of Transformation
ancient_tome.description: Ancient knowledge about becoming a lich. This could be your spell source.

crystal_heart.name: Crystallized Heart
crystal_heart.description: A heart transformed into pure crystal. Pulses with magical energy. This could be your rare component.

drone_parts.name: Drone Parts
drone_parts.description: Salvaged parts from destroyed security drones

rat_tail.name: Mutant Rat Tail
rat_tail.description: A tail from a mutated rat

security_keycard.name: Security Keycard
security_keycard.description: A keycard from a Prime Elite Guard

credits.name: Prime Credits
credits.description: The official currency of Prime Corporation

admin_access_chip.name: Admin Access Chip
admin_access_chip.description: Grants access to Prime Archive terminals

greeting.text: You look lost. First time in the underground?

choices.text: I'm looking for information about... alternative healthcare.

greeting_repeat.text: Back again? What do you need?

healthcare_info.text: 300-year waiting list, right? Prime's way of saying 'never'. But there are... other options. Older paths. If you're willing to go beyond what Prime controls.

choices.text: Tell me more about these 'older paths'.

market_info.text: This is where people come when Prime's system fails them. Which is most people. We trade what Prime doesn't want us to have - medicine, real food, information, freedom.

choices.text: Interesting. What else can you tell me?

lichdom_hint.text: Magic. Real magic, not Prime's tech. Some say you can transcend mortality entirely. Become something beyond their control. A lich - undead, immortal. You'd have all the time in the world.

quest_start.text: You need three things: a spell source, a rare component, and a magical location. Dr. Morgan at the old library might know about spell sources. The Collector here sometimes has rare items. And magical places... you'll have to search.

addQuest.name: Find the Spell Source
addQuest.description: Seek out Dr. Morgan at the abandoned library

danger_warning.text: Dangerous? Sure. But so is waiting 300 years to be yourself. Pick your danger.

choices.text: I need to think about this.

skepticism.text: Fifty years ago, they said the internet was fantasy. A hundred years ago, airplanes. Prime's taught us that only their tech matters. But magic never left - it just went underground.

choices.text: Maybe you're right. How do I start?

resistance_info.text: We're people who refuse to live under Prime's control. Some of us sabotage their systems. Others build alternatives. And some... some of us are seeking power beyond their reach.

join_resistance.text: Then prove it. Prime's got a data center nearby. Get us access codes and we'll know you're serious.

addQuest.name: Prove Your Worth
addQuest.description: Steal access codes from a Prime facility

greeting.text: Fascinating. Another seeker of knowledge in this forgotten place. What brings you to my dusty refuge?

choices.text: I'm looking for information about transformation magic.

greeting_repeat.text: Ah, back for more knowledge? The books and I are patient.

transformation_query.text: Transformation... yes. The old magic of becoming. Prime buried this knowledge because it threatens their control. But some texts survive. What specifically interests you?

choices.text: Lichdom. Becoming undead to escape time.

lichdom_explanation.text: Ah. The ultimate transformation. Trading life for unlife, mortality for eternity. It requires great sacrifice and greater will. But yes, it's possible. The texts are here.

choices.text: I need those texts. It's urgent.

spell_source_quest.text: I can help you. But the complete tome is hidden - buried in digital form on a Prime server they don't monitor anymore. You'll need technical skills... or Sense to find a way in.

sense_check.text: Impressive. Here - this data chip contains an old admin access. You'll need to physically access a terminal in the Prime Archive. Dangerous, but you seem capable.

addItem.name: Admin Access Chip
addItem.description: Grants access to Prime Archive terminals

library_history.text: Prime declared physical books 'obsolete' twenty years ago. They digitized what they approved, destroyed the rest. I... salvaged what I could. Knowledge they wanted erased.

sacrifice_explanation.text: Lichdom requires giving up pieces of yourself. Your health, your relationships, your humanity. Each step toward immortality costs you something mortal. The ritual itself demands everything you are - and remakes you into something new.

greeting.text: Hey neighbor. Another day, another shift operating drones for our Prime overlords, right?

choices.text: Do you ever think about leaving?

wellbeing_check.text: Honestly? Barely. Ten hours a day watching screens, making sure drones deliver on time. If I'm two seconds slow, my performance score drops. Lower score means higher rent. It's a trap.

choices.text: There has to be another way.
I'm sorry you're going through this.

escape_talk.text: All the time. But where would I go? Prime owns everything. Every city, every job, every service. There's no 'leaving' anymore.

choices.text: What if we didn't need their system at all?

hope_discussion.text: Is there? You sound like you've got something in mind.

choices.text: I'm working on it. I'll let you know.

alternative_systems.text: Now that's interesting. If you find something real, something that works... I want in. We all deserve better than this.

greeting.text: Rare items. Strange items. Items Prime doesn't want you to have. What's your interest?

choices.text: I need a rare magical component.
What do you have for sale?

magical_component.text: For lichdom? Ambitious. I have something... a crystallized heart. Ripped from a living being and transformed through magic. Extremely rare. Extremely expensive.

choices.text: Is there another way to get one?

price_negotiation.text: 5000 Prime Credits. Or... you could do me a favor. Prime's got a shipment coming through - rare artifacts. Get me three pieces from that shipment, and the heart is yours.

addQuest.name: The Prime Train Heist
addQuest.description: Steal artifacts from a Prime shipment

alternative_acquisition.text: Create one yourself. But that means sacrificing something deeply important to you - transforming it magically. Most people can't stomach that cost.

greeting.text: Welcome, sibling. This is a safe space. You can rest here. What brings you to us?

guidance_request.text: I've guided many on their journeys. What troubles you?

choices.text: I'm seeking lichdom to outlast Prime's waiting lists.
How do we survive in this world?

lichdom_guidance.text: A radical choice. But then, our existence has always been radical. Transformation as resistance. Remember - becoming lich doesn't mean abandoning who you are. It means transcending their limits.

choices.text: Thank you. I needed to hear that.

community_discussion.text: We all do. In a world that tries to erase us, finding each other is survival. And resistance.

survival_wisdom.text: We survive by refusing to disappear. By building systems of care when theirs fail us. By being there for each other. And sometimes, by finding power in unexpected places.

greeting.text: Citizen. State your business at this facility.

choices.text: Just checking my waiting list status.

emergency_care.text: Emergency care requires Premium subscription or immediate payment of 10,000 credits. Do you have either?

quests.name: Find the Spell Source
quests.description: Seek out Dr. Morgan at the abandoned library to learn about the spell source needed for lichdom

quests.name: Prove Your Worth
quests.description: Steal access codes from a Prime facility to prove your loyalty to the resistance

quests.name: The Prime Train Heist
quests.description: Steal three rare artifacts from a Prime shipment on their high-speed train

quests.name: The Lichdom Ritual
quests.description: Gather all three components and perform the ritual to become a lich
